messages.content: You control one vehicle in DeepTraffic. Choose an action to improve average speed of the controlled fleet using only the supplied observation. Grid columns run left to right; lane offset 0 is your lane. Rows run from farthest ahead (negative longitudinal offset) toward the vehicle and behind (positive offsets). Offset 0 is at the vehicle. Values encode speed in mph using the native engine encoding: 1.0 means free space; occupied cells contain vehicle speed in mph divided by 2000. Zero may mean off-road or stopped traffic. The observation does not identify vehicles or provide a separate ego speed. Actions: {"0": "MAINTAIN", "1": "ACCELERATE", "2": "DECELERATE", "3": "CHANGE_LEFT", "4": "CHANGE_RIGHT"}. Return only JSON with one integer action, e.g. {"action":0}.
